nameOfQualification: Jute Manufacturing Technician (Elective 1 Jute Yarn, Elective 2: Jute fabric)
description: Jute Manufacturing Technician is responsible for efficiently handling modern Spinning machines including preparatory and Jute Batching or modern looms (Rapier, S-4A and one mack etc.) including preparatory and Jute finishing. As Jute Manufacturing Technician, S/he makes necessary arrangements including checking of quality of jute sliver, jute yarn, jute warp beam and jute weft package availability including its quality. To run efficiently and ensure sustainability of production process S/he requires skill on mechanism of Spreader / Softener, Carding, Drawing and Spinning machine spare parts function, knowledge of different carding action, draft and doubling mechanism of loom, spare parts function, knowledge of different motions of loom, tension control mechanism, lubrication schedule, maintenance, detection of yarn /fabric faults and Testing and Quality Control of Jute yarn, fabric on quality of jute packaging materials.
